text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Tracen Academy
tryouts—an event where debut
hopefuls
show off their racing talents in the hopes
of being scouted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the morning of the big day arrives, I
quickly head toward the
course to find...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You must be... the lost trainer I met
the other day?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, forgive me. I couldn't help
it—that was quite a memorable
day.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I presume you're here to watch the
tryouts? I'll be running in the final
group,
so I'd be happy if you stay to see it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, I must be off to get prepared. It's
rather sunny today, so do
take care to
keep in the shade.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder still has that serene tone as
she heads towards the
track with a tranquil
smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The races fly by, moving swiftly from one
to the next.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! My group's up next... I-I'm so
nervous!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Spe, you need to loosen up.
Careful, or you'll turn to stone
before the
race starts, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Stone?! I-I won't be able to run very well
like that!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's all right, Spe. Remain calm... Stay
relaxed...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Remember, "Do your best and let the
heavens do the rest." You've
trained with
all your might for this day, have you not?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You need only trust in yourself, run true to
your heart, and the
outcome will surely be
glorious.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aw, Grass! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Think nothing of it... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ummm... El? Might I ask you to move over?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué? Uh, like this?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: What's this about, Grass? ...Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the next moment, a racer loses control
on the turn and hurtles off
the track
straight towards them!

text_block_list.name: Racer
text_block_list.text: Oh nooooo! Gosh, sorry!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Are you hurt? You should have someone
check on you, to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Racer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I will... I'm really sorry about that!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Uh, take care now...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Dios mío! She almost scared me to death!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But, Grass, that was amazing! I don't know
how you could stay so
calm!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's nothing. I'm simply glad El
wasn't injured.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
That's Grass Wonder, right? This is such an
important day, but she's
totally chill! That
mindset of hers could be a killer weapon.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She's not just mentally strong... Judging
from her record, she's a force
to be
reckoned with. No wonder she's the most
anticipated in the
final group.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Grass Wonder draws eyes from all
around, the time for her race
finally
begins!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Continuing to hold everyone's attention,
she calmly sticks to the
middle pack, as if
waiting to see how the race will turn out,
until...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Grass Wonder just jumped out
front! But... isn't her running
kinda...
strange?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I think the racer alongside her got shaky.
Look at the course—it's in
bad shape after
that last race.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Grass Wonder ran up ahead to
avoid a potential collision.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's in the lead with only 200
meters to go! The
competition's not far
behind!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Can she stay ahead?! And the winner is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Grass Wonder was ahead until
the last moment, but lost it
by a nose,
finishing second.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hey, nice work, Grass! You, well...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how unfortunate! I lost it by a mere
step.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But this experience will serve me well. I
will endeavor to make the
next race a
first-place victory.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uh, y-yeah! Let's both try real hard!

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
What a bummer for Grass. Without that
hiccup in the middle, I bet
she had the
skills to pull off first place!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
But that blink-of-the-eye response was
brilliant. I'd love to have her
on the team!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the final result, everyone seems
impressed by Grass's
performance. I'm sure
she'll get plenty of trainers coming to
scout her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At least, that's what I thought...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, El? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Training tonight? I'd be up to join you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I think not... Today's race has taken a toll
on me, so I plan on resting
up.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: If you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not long after, a certain rumor began to
spread around the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Grass Wonder turns down every single
scouting offer."
